species.season: Harvest May 1–July 31 and Sept. 1–Dec. 5; catch-and-release only Jan 1–Apr 30 (limited areas Mar–Apr) and Dec 6–31; all areas closed Aug 1–31
species.size: Must be at least 19" and cannot exceed 24"
species.quote: May 1–May 31: 1 fish per person per day. Must be at least 19" and cannot exceed 24" (designated waters). June 1–July 31: All areas open, same limits. Aug. 1–31: All areas closed to striped bass fishing. Sept. 1–Dec. 5: All areas open, same limits. Dec. 6–31 and Jan. 1–Feb. 28: catch and release only. Mar. 1–Apr. 30: catch and release only in the lower Bay.
species.notes: May 1–31 harvest is limited to designated areas; Susquehanna Flats and lower Susquehanna/Northeast River follow the same structure. Check the Maryland striped bass page for area lines.
